flags.note: Extended — 100% up its 52-week range, RS 100, 0% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Automobile & Auto Components is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.53) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management expects the motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects its export volume to move to 2,20,000-plus units per month in the current quarter.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company is undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to 9 million units per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Key areas for capacity expansion will include electric vehicles for two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The key areas to address will be EVs, both two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles and three-wheelers." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Debt is being paid down - interest cost should keep falling.
A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 28 Cr -> 98 Cr (250%) as of Mar 2026

opportunities.point: The shares trade under the model's intrinsic value.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 14,760 vs price 11,432 - margin of safety 22.5%

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 13.5% earnings growth vs 17% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international key markets is very positive.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The domestic motorcycle industry had a split trajectory in FY26, featuring a muted first half followed by a strong second half.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Domestic motorcycles, the industry had a split trajectory in FY '26 with a muted first half, followed by a strong recovery in the second half." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 24% vs profit 17% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Operations were suspended for a few days due to a ransomware attack while exercising abundant caution.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully. Though exercising abundant caution, we suspended operations..." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Disruptions impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, particularly affecting exports, high-end bikes, and EVs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Supply chain difficulties regarding LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics impaired service availability by about 10% to 15%.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.
